sloka: मदधीनं तु यत्तन्मे हृदयं त्वयि वर्तते ।पराधीनेषु गात्रेषु किं करिष्याम्यनीश्वरा ।। ६.११९.९ ।।
transliteration: madadhīnaṁ tu yattanme hṛdayaṁ tvayi vartate ।parādhīneṣu gātreṣu kiṁ kariṣyāmyanīśvarā ।। 6.119.9 ।।

translations.english: "That mind which is under my control is my heart and it abides in you. What can I do about my limbs when I am at others' mercy?"
